Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to synthesize the available information and prematurely shifted the investigation strategy. In Step 3, the WebSurfer successfully retrieved a source (worldmusicianobituaries.org) that explicitly stated Lee Hazlewood died in "Henderson, Nevada" on August 4, 2007. Despite this clear confirmation of the place of death, the Planner in Step 4 incorrectly concluded that the "exact place of death was not consistently confirmed" and issued redundant instructions to search for the place of death again. This represents a failure to recognize that the task requirements (writer and who died in 2007) were effectively met, leading to unnecessary agent engagement and a loop of redundant searches.
